title: Dutch Statenvertaling (States Bible, 1637), full Bible, one verse per line
period: 17th century (1637), early-modern Dutch in an older spelling
notes: License stated as 'Public Domain' in the source README at https://github.com/scrollmapper/bible_databases/blob/59b18c5af5845728c275d5b7178ad0d024172b1f/sources/nl/DutSVV/README.md (scrollmapper/bible_databases, files from the CrossWire SWORD module DutSVV). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 4,625,226 bytes; one verse per line as '[c:v] text' with '### Book' headings in English (66 short headings, negligible). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'dutch') gives 4,202,669 characters.
